ruleChecks.note: 이표식 적챔피언 HP가 스킬랭크와영구강화에 따른문턱10.5/11.5/12.5%미만이면봉인. 첫랭크고정조건제거.
챔피언 봉인 발생시에만 영향을 받은다른챔피언 표식초기화,일반피격마다 초기화하지 않는다.
표식효과종료 후 봉인된챔피언1명 이상이면유물낙하. 근처생존적 인원과 다르다.
유물획득시 봉인챔피언마다 문턱0.5%영구증가와 이스킬총CD20%환급. AD를 참조하지 않는다.

repairs.quote: Locke throws a binding artifact to a location, dealing (150/225/300 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slowing enemies in the area by 99%, decaying over 2 seconds. The artifact marks enemies hit for 5 seconds, sealing away marked enemy champions brought below 10.5/11.5/12.5%, and resetting the duration of the mark on other affected champions. After the duration ends, if at least one champion was sealed, the artifact lands on the ground. Locke can pick up the artifact to permanently increase its execution threshold by 0.5%, and refund 20% of his total Cooldown, for each champion sealed. The artifact will linger on the ground for this Ability's current Cooldown at the time of sealing.
